text-field.$note: Shared visual foundation for all text-input-style components (input, select, textarea, date-picker). Components reference this base — changing it changes all text fields uniformly.

textarea.$note: Extends text-field but replaces fixed height with min-height. No icon slots — trailing/leading icons don't apply to multi-line input.
textarea.$exception: Textarea min-heights are hardcoded — content-area minimums specific to multi-line input, not derivable from sizing primitives.

toggle-base.$note: Shared size ladder for the binary toggles. The box, the mark and the checked fill belong to the UA — accent-color points them at the brand — so the size of the indicator is the only decision left here.
toggle-base.$exception: Toggle indicator sizes are hardcoded — proportional to the control's visual weight, not derived from icon or component-height primitives.

radio.$note: The same control as checkbox with the UA drawing a circle instead of a box, and exclusive within a name group. No radius of its own: the shape is the input type, not a token.

switch.$exception: Switch track dimensions are hardcoded as a cohesive set — width:height ratio is intentional and should not drift independently via primitives.

form-field.$note: A column with a gap, and nothing that ramps — so it declares only a $constant, which lifts to the base rule. A component in APPEARANCE_ONLY with no schema at all emits nothing, and the atom ends up carrying the layout itself — which is what the $constant is here to prevent. Spacing is {scale.1} like every other component here.

helper-text.$note: Subordinate to the label by colour alone. label and action read one size ramp at one weight, so the only separation left is on-surface-variant against on-surface. The font-weight below does not change that — nothing reads a component's typography block except text-transform, so font-family and font-weight there are inert.
